guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: dry Alice in Chains acoustic-electric grit with dark strum texture
tone.profile: dry Alice in Chains acoustic-electric grit with dark strum texture
tone.summary: A clean signal chain using a boost for attack, followed by an AC30 or US Deluxe to simulate the dry, dark tone of Alice in Chains' acoustic textures, finished with minimal room ambience.
corrections: Replace fuzz/high gain with acoustic-electric grit
Keep it mostly dry and percussive

rig.name: Alice in Chains - Got Me Wrong - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Enhance the acoustic attack and percussive strumming feel.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a pick-attack boost, crucial for acoustic grit.

alternatives.reason: Compression could also enhance sustain and body.

blocks.purpose: Introduce subtle, controlled grit and edge without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: RAT-style provides a controllable, mid-focused dirt suitable for 'grit'.

alternatives.reason: A milder overdrive could also achieve the desired grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide a clean, dark, and articulate tone suitable for acoustic-electric textures.
blocks.gap: US Deluxe is ideal for clear, punchy tones without excessive coloration.

alternatives.reason: Could work if a slightly more British voicing was desired.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a close-mic'd, focused sound source.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 provides the necessary clarity and focus for DI/acoustic simulation.

alternatives.reason: Similar size, but US 2x12 is often better for clean articulation.

blocks.purpose: Darken the overall tone and emphasize the low-mids for body.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is necessary to achieve the 'dark low-mid body' specified in the verdict.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and depth without sounding lush or distracting.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring for a natural, contained acoustic feel.

alternatives.reason: Could be used if the room sound needs to be slightly more metallic.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a tighter, darker acoustic-electric sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance dark low-mid body and close mic focus.
